rows.grounds: action of pressing out the water

items.question: How many times and in what manner must the water be squeezed before use?
premises: Water is the substance being prepared.
The water must be squeezed six times.
The squeezing must be done repeatedly.
items.inference: The water is to be prepared by squeezing it six times repeatedly.
uncertainties: The surface muhurmu?huḥ contains an unexpected character, possibly a textual corruption of muhurmuhuḥ.
items.plain_english: But indeed, having squeezed the water six times and again and again.
